jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Part-Time (City Clerk)
jobs.description:
**DEFINITION**
--------------

**Come join the team at the beautiful City of Redondo Beach as a part-time Program Coordinator! The current opening is in the City Clerk's Office.**

  
Under direction of a supervisor, this position is responsible for performing paraprofessional duties. This position assists in phones, counter, retention and destruction process with the departments, and election related duties like educating residents on Ranked Choice Voting, picking up ballots, verify ballot signatures, and prepare ballots for tabulation.
  
  
*This is a part-time, at-will position that is not eligible for City benefits.* *After application submission, the hiring department will contact candidates directly, and not all candidates may be contacted.*

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS**
---------------------------------------------------------

Sample duties include, but are not limited to:

Performs paraprofessional staff support by coordinating assigned tasks related to the public records requests and projects; implements directions from superiors that are provided orally and/or in writing; compiles and edits data; prepares reports that include conclusions and recommendations; composes, types, edits and reviews memos and correspondences; receives service requests and provides information to the public in person, by telephone, or through written correspondence where judgment, knowledge and interpretive skills may be required; reviews and checks documents, records and forms; and performs other related duties as required.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

Knowledge of: Materials, equipment, regulations, principles, procedures and practices related to youth and senior activities, recreational programs, group activities, games and sports; applicable health and safety regulations; first aid; record keeping practices and procedures; modern office practices, procedures and equipment; report writing; basic mathematical computations; applicable sections of the California Vehicle Code.
  
  
Ability to: Meet medical and physical employment standards for the classification; read, write, speak and understand English; understand and follow oral and written directions; compose correspondence, brochures, flyers and other informational documents; provide information to the public in person, by telephone, or through written correspondence where judgment, knowledge and interpretive skills may be required; communicate effectively orally and in writing; work overtime as necessary; establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers and members of the public; legally operate a motor vehicle in the State of California.
  
  
Education and Experience: Effective leadership skills, creativity, good decision making and exercising appropriate judgment, the ability to teach, and the ability to lead by example are preferred qualities. Must be at least 18 years of age to apply. Must possess a valid California Driver's License. Completion of high school is required, and some college course work a related field is highly desired.

**SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION**
----------------------------

**SELECTION PROCESS:**

The selection process may include but is not limited to: Application review and evaluation, written examination, performance test and interview. All employment offers made by the City are contingent upon establishing proof of a prospective candidate's legal authorization to work in the United States and successfully passing all components of the pre-employment process. The pre-employment process may include but not be limited to: Reference checks, background investigation, fingerprint-based criminal history check, credit check, degree verification, and post-offer medical examination and drug test. For public safety positions, including positions based in the Police and/or Fire Department(s), the pre-employment process may also include but not be limited to a P.O.S.T. compliant background check, polygraph examination, post-offer medical examination and drug test, and post-offer psychological examination.

Candidates must fill out the employment application and supplemental questions completely and accurately. Required fields and supplemental questions are noted with an asterisk (\*). All other fields are optional. Applications including references to "see resume" are considered incomplete and will be disqualified.

The City of Redondo Beach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The City will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer. Candidates with a disability who may need accommodation during the selection process must notify the Human Resources Department at least five (5) business days in advance of the test date.

Qualified Military Veterans are given an additional five points to a passing score for both open-competitive and promotional recruitments. Documentation of such service, such as a veteran identification card or DD214, must be provided along with the application for employment or before the conclusion of the testing process.

jobs.description:
**Partner with us in making a positive change!**
================================================

Join a team where your work truly matters. We're proud to have been certified as a Great Place to Work for 8 years by our own employees. We invite you to partner with us in our mission to improve mental healthcare.

**Job Title:**

Overnight Program Coordinator

**Division/Program:**

Los Angeles: USC Crisis Residential Treatment (VS)

**Starting Compensation:**

72,750-75,000 USD Per Year

**Working Location:**

Los Angeles, CA 90033

**Working Hours/Shift:**

Tuesday- Saturday 11pm- 7:30am

**Why Join Our Team?**

* **Competitive Compensation**: Offering a salary that matches your skills and experience.
* **Generous Time Off**: Enjoy ample vacation and holiday pay.

**Comprehensive Benefits Package**:

* Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Additional voluntary benefits to support your lifestyle.

**Professional Growth Opportunities**:

* On-the-job training with access to paid CEU opportunities.
* Career development programs designed to help you grow.
* Supervision for BBS hours for AMFT, ACSW, and APCC professionals (where applicable).

**Employee Recognition & Rewards**: A culture that celebrates and rewards your hard work and dedication

**What you bring to SBHG** (Qualifications)**:**

**Education**

* Associate degree or bachelor’s degree **required**. Field of study: Social Science, Clinical Psychology, Clinical Social Work, Rehabilitation Therapy, or related field of study, preferred. **OR**
* Graduated from an accredited school of Licensed Vocational Nursing (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technology (LPT) **required**.

**Experience** **Required**:

* Associate degree with five (5) years of full-time experience in community mental health setting serving individuals with mental illness.
* Bachelor’s degree with four (4) years of full-time experience in community mental health setting serving individuals with mental illness.
* LVN or LPT with four (4) years of in community mental health setting serving individuals with mental illness.
* One (1) year supervisory experience in a mental health setting.

**Preferred** **Experience**:

  

* Inpatient or residential experience/ supervisory experience

**License OR Certification** **Required****:**

* Valid California Driver’s License

**License OR Certification** **Preferred****:**

* Registered Nurse (CA), LMFT, LCSW, LPCC

This position has primary responsibility for implementing the rehabilitation program of and oversee programming overnight at the Crisis Residential Treatment Center (CRT). This position ensures that each client receives supervision, nursing care, treatment, medications and diet, as per program guidelines and treatment plan. This position is responsible for the implementation and oversight of all regulatory requirements as per the guidelines set forth by CCL, DCHS, , TJC, etc. Provides direction and supervision to direct service staff and participates as a member of the leadership team.

**Division & Program Overview:**

**Facility & Setting:**

* 16-bed residential facility offering a short-term, home-like environment.

**Clinical Services:** Comprehensive physical/psychological evaluations, mental health counseling, and case management.

**Skills & Transition:** Life-skills and interpersonal training, paired with dedicated assistance for locating permanent housing.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

To further the mission of the YMCA by providing a safe, inclusive, and engaging environment for youth. The Camp Counselor II is responsible for leading, training, and supervising a team of Camp Counselor I staff in delivering progressive, age-appropriate programs and specialized activities throughout the summer season. This role oversees residential duties to ensure staff foster a positive and supportive cabin community, maintains the highest standards of health, safety, and proactive risk management, ensures the responsible stewardship of camp facilities and equipment, and serves as a positive role model who consistently embodies the YMCA Core Values.+

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**STAFF SUPERVISION & TEAM LEADERSHIP**

* Lead, train, and supervise a team of Camp Counselor I staff serving as a positive role model and demonstrating best practices in camper engagement, behavior management, and camp operations
* Utilize prior experience to anticipate daily camp needs, take initiative during transitions, and proactively assist staff in understanding camp routines and standard operating procedures.
* Play a leading role in elevating safety standards by actively guiding peers and direct reports in the proper execution of emergency protocols, radio procedures, and YMCA Core Values.

**PROGRAM OVERSIGHT & QUALITY CONTROL**

* Ensure staff develop, facilitate, and deliver progressive, mission-driven activities tailored to the ages and abilities of the campers.
* Guide staff in debriefing activities with participants to reinforce learning and participate in continuous improvement efforts by evaluating the success of the program.
* Maintain effective, positive relationships with members, participants, and fellow staff to promote a supportive camp culture and prioritize overall youth well-being.
* Prepare & Develop activity areas, provide appropriate orientations, and teach the proper and safe use of equipment to ensure positive outcomes.
* Debrief activities with participants to reinforce learning and participate in continuous improvement efforts by evaluating the success of the program.
* Ensure staff assigned to specialized activities (High/Low Ropes, Lifeguarding, Reptiles & Animal Care, Archery, Mountain Bikes) hold required certifications and strictly follow specific manufacturer and industry safety guidelines.

**HEALTH, SAFETY & RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Oversee staff in continuously monitoring participants, equipment, facilities, and environmental conditions continuously to identify, mitigate, and report hazardous or unsafe conditions.
* Ensure all staff review and execute all emergency procedures immediately in accordance with YMCA policies, maintaining readiness for specific scenarios including missing campers, first aid responses, and facility failures.
* Use problem-solving skills to make quick decisions, direct staff during critical incidents, and ensure that both staff and campers follow all established safety procedures.
* Play an active role in elevating safety standards, maintaining clear and professional communication via standard radio procedures during daily operations and critical incidents.

**FACILITY, EQUIPMENT & OPERATIONAL STEWARDSHIP**

* Monitor staff compliance with pre-use inspections, ensuring the team demonstrates good stewardship of camp resources through the proper care, maintenance, and storage of all supplies.
* Clean, secure, and organize program areas following each use, and assist in packing materials both on a daily basis and at the close of the season.
* Verify that all staff complete required YMCA and American Camp Association (ACA) training, certifications, and annual skills assessments prior to facilitating any activities.
* Ensure required documentation is completed efficiently and promptly report any escalated incidents, hazards, policy violations, or operational concerns to management.

**COMPLIANCE, TRAINING & ADMINISTRATION**

* Complete all required YMCA and American Camp Association (ACA) training, certifications, and annual skills assessments prior to facilitating any activities.
* Follow all risk management and manufacturer guidelines, operating equipment only as authorized and seeking guidance when a task falls outside current training.
* Complete required documentation efficiently and promptly report any incidents, hazards, policy violations, or operational concerns to management.

jobs.title: Public Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20182677 **Category** Support Services

  

In order for your application to be considered, please attach a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

  
  

The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) is seeking a **Public Communications Coordinator** to join its team. As part of our growing communications team, this position will work alongside another Communications Coordinator to support the team’s expanding communications and outreach efforts. The **Public Communications Coordinator** will work with a multidisciplinary team to develop and disseminate resources that promote and enable longitudinal and cross-country analyses on aging, health, and retirement, including contextualizing and communicating newly available resources and data on exposures over the lifespan that increase dementia and other disease risk. This position requires a curious communicator who can learn, distill, and disseminate complex, technical information to a wide variety of audiences.

  
  

This is a grant funded, one year fixed term position with a hybrid work arrangement.

**Job responsibilities include:**

* Developing and maintaining communications materials
  + Drafting website content and announcements (e.g., newsletters, blogs)
  + Evaluating existing resources and editing content as necessary
  + Reviewing and copy-editing research products (e.g., journal articles, policy briefs, op-eds)
  + Maintaining and growing social media presence (e.g., X, LinkedIn; developing short-form videos or posts)
  + Creating conference and event materials (e.g., brochures/flyers, exhibit posters)
* Distilling complex, technical research topics into clear, concise, and effective content to share with a variety of audiences, both technical and non-technical
* Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely completion and distribution of communications materials
* Reviewing and revising project resources and other written materials to ensure quality, readability, and consistency
* Experience or interest in developing a communications strategy to publicize the research project and grow its audience; this may include pitching investigators and other subject matter experts for news articles, media appearances, and op-eds
  

  

**Qualifications:**

Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts, make them easily understandable through varied mediums, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine content.

  
  

Ability to collaborate effectively with numerous project stakeholders (e.g., investigators, administrative staff, university officials) at the university and with collaborators at other research institutions. Strong editing skills, ranging from developmental editing to copyediting. Graphic design experience is a plus but not required.

  
  

Minimum education: Bachelor’s Degree

  
  

Minimum Experience: 2+ years (3+ years preferred). Background in communications, public relations, marketing, or a related field is required. A background or experience working in academia or with clients in public health, economics, or policy is not required, but is preferred.

  
  

**Work Arrangement:**

Hybrid (3 days per week) on the University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA.

**Compensation**

The hourly rate range for this position is $31.97 - $35.35. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  
  

**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**

The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy & Government Service develops evidence-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, the USC Schaeffer Institute includes four flagship centers: the Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics, the Center for Economic and Social Research, the Center for Civic Society and the Leonard D. Schaeffer Fellows in Government Service.

The Schaeffer Institute is home to more than 150 scholars and staff, including three Nobel Laureates and seven members of the National Academy of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. Schaeffer experts have testified before numerous Congressional committees and are regularly sought out by media outlets—including the New York Times, NPR, Stat, Wall Street Journal, and Washington Post—to provide insight on policy issues.

The Institute has offices at USC in Los Angeles and at the USC Capital Campus in Washington, DC.

**About the Center for Civic Society at the Schaeffer Institute**

The Center for Civic Society aims to assess, strengthen and promote democratic values around the world through research, civic engagement and global dialogue. Chaired by Former Prime Minister Gordon Brown and led by Anna Saavedra, the Center for Civic Society was launched in 2026 and is dedicated to bridging political, social and economic divides through evidence-based research that informs and promotes better public policy.

Ranked among the foremost schools of public policy in the nation, the USC Sol Price School of Public Policy generates uncommon knowledge for the common good. The school is composed of overlapping disciplines that generate innovative approaches to critical issues ranging from health-care policy to homelessness, and sustainability to congestion – to name a few. jobs.title: Coordinator, Publicity
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

The Hulu and ABC Publicity team is seeking a Coordinator, Publicity to provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity while developing hands-on experience across the day-to-day work of the publicity function. This role is designed for someone who has a genuine interest in pursuing a career in entertainment publicity and is eager to build a strong foundation in both executive support and publicity coordination.

The Coordinator will focus on becoming highly proficient in core desk responsibilities, including calendar management, expenses, meetings, and team administration. As the individual demonstrates proficiency, they will have opportunities to take on broader publicity assignments, including media monitoring, press materials, campaign logistics, events, and special projects. Administrative support will remain an important and ongoing part of the position.

This is a developmental role intended to integrate the Coordinator into the daily needs of the business, strengthen their publicity skills, and prepare them for continued growth within the function.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity, including managing two complex calendars, coordinating meetings and conference calls, and navigating schedule changes.
* Prepare and submit expense reports; support invoices, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and other departmental administrative processes.
* Maintain team contact lists, departmental documents, status reports, and shared resources.
* Coordinate staff meetings and other group meetings; take notes, track action items, and distribute relevant information to the team.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Build strong working relationships across the Hulu and ABC Publicity teams and with internal and external partners.
* Balance the priorities of two Vice Presidents and two publicity teams, communicating proactively when needs or deadlines compete.

**As the Role Progresses, You Will Have Opportunities To:**

* Support publicity coordination activities such as media monitoring, compiling and distributing press coverage, maintaining press lists and media-site materials, and researching industry trends and media opportunities.
* Assist with drafting and proofreading publicity materials, including episodic loglines, biographies, press releases, announcements, and other campaign documents.
* Help coordinate talent and campaign logistics, including travel, schedules, glam, screenings, press junkets, panels, premieres, awards events, and other publicity activities.
* Participate in team brainstorms and contribute to campaign, event, and special-project execution.
* Support publicity events as needed, including occasional evenings and weekends.
* Take on additional publicity responsibilities based on demonstrated proficiency, capacity, business needs, and readiness, while continuing to provide essential administrative support.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated interest in building a career in entertainment publicity; candidates seeking a role focused solely on executive administration may not be the best fit.
* Prior administrative, communications, publicity, marketing, agency, studio, network, platform, or related experience.
* Ability to learn and become proficient in executive desk responsibilities while showing initiative and curiosity about the broader publicity function.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and time-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional judgment and ability to handle confidential information discreetly.
* Collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented approach with a strong team mentality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Google Suite.
* Ability to balance the priorities of two senior executives and two publicity teams, exercise sound judgment, and communicate proactively when needs or deadlines compete.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of relevant administrative, publicity, communications, marketing, or entertainment experience.
* Familiarity with publicity and media-monitoring tools such as Muck Rack, TVEyes, or similar services.
* Knowledge of television, streaming, entertainment, media, and pop-culture trends.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Production Coordinator - Disney Television Animation
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**About this Role and our Studio**

Disney Television Animation (DTVA) has over forty years of legacy as a top producer of kids & family entertainment. Our work is integral to The Walt Disney Company, bringing Disney-branded characters and stories to families’ homes across the globe.

  

DTVA creates both long-form and short-form content spanning traditional 2D, rig-based 2D, CG (preschool), CG (premium), and stop-motion. We create shows in a broad range of unique and innovative styles, and we aim to match the right talent with the right production in terms of skill and artistic style.

By submitting an application for this **Production Coordinator** job posting, you may be considered for any **Production Coordinator** positions that arise until the expiration date provided.

  

**Applications submitted to this job posting will remain valid until April 30, 2027.**

The Production Coordinator works on a project through the completion of pre-production. As Coordinator, they are available to help the Producers, Production Managers and or Production Supervisors on all tasks during pre-production and production (if applicable).

**What You Will Do**

*Planning*

* Coordinate any/all of the following meetings: Storyboard Handouts, Design Reviews, Pitches, Leica Screenings, Art Approvals, Animatic Reviews and any additional Production specific requests.
* Break down scripts for Storyboard Handouts and Design meetings.
* Research and locate reference for the crew, as needed.

*Collaboration*

* Work with the other show Coordinators and/or Production Associate to maintain artwork and production files as per standard TVA procedures.
* Assist in the preparation of materials for the Vendor studio, Production Executives, and/or other Disney partners as requested.
* Partner with the PM to ensure that all show elements and production materials are archived as per WDTVA and studio policy.
* Partner with the PM to attend and take notes at Retake sessions as well as distribute notes to the Vendor studio and internal production team.
* Help with event planning and crew activities as needed.
* Partner with the PM and/or AP/LP to ensure that all Storyboards are conformed, pitch and due dates are on track, S&P and Legal department changes are addressed and that Exec creative notes are reviewed and implemented. Communicate any production delays to the PM and AP/LP.
* Perform all other applicable duties as assigned by TVA Leadership and per TVA policies and procedures.

*Organization*

* Enter artwork in the “Insight” database. Track all artwork including characters, props and location designs.
* Create, distribute and maintain the episode Design Lists throughout the production process – from Storyboard to Shipping.
Prepare and send complete digital shipping packages of episodes to Vendor studio.  

  

*Communication*

* Confirm receipt and follow up on any issues/questions that come back from the Vendor studio.
* Prepare and distribute necessary materials for artists that work in-house, freelance and daily call.
* Partner with Artistic Leadership to ensure that the team has what they need to complete their weekly assignments. Flag any issues/problems to the PM and AP/LP as necessary.

*Technical Skills*

* Proficient computer skills; Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook; ToonBoom Storyboard Pro; Adobe Photoshop; Insight; Ftrack or other Production tracking tools
* Excellent organizational skills, strong written & verbal communication skills

**Additional duties as assigned.**

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

  

* 3+ years in animated television series production
* Ability to oversee multiple tasks and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
* Positive attitude with the ability to be flexible
* Excellent organizational, verbal, written, e-social skills and acumen
* Mac or PC proficient.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Office – knowledgeable use of Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook and PowerPoint
* Final Draft
* Adobe Acrobat Pro
* Adobe Photoshop

The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) is seeking a **Public Communications Coordinator** to join its team. As part of our growing communications team, this position will work alongside another Communications Coordinator to support the team’s expanding communications and outreach efforts. The **Public Communications Coordinator** will work with a multidisciplinary team to develop and disseminate resources that promote and enable longitudinal and cross-country analyses on aging, health, and retirement, including contextualizing and communicating newly available resources and data on exposures over the lifespan that increase dementia and other disease risk. This position requires a curious communicator who can learn, distill, and disseminate complex, technical information to a wide variety of audiences.

This is a grant funded, one year fixed term position with a hybrid work arrangement.

**Job responsibilities include:**

* Developing and maintaining communications materials
  + Drafting website content and announcements (e.g., newsletters, blogs)
  + Evaluating existing resources and editing content as necessary
  + Reviewing and copy-editing research products (e.g., journal articles, policy briefs, op-eds)
  + Maintaining and growing social media presence (e.g., X, LinkedIn; developing short-form videos or posts)
  + Creating conference and event materials (e.g., brochures/flyers, exhibit posters)
* Distilling complex, technical research topics into clear, concise, and effective content to share with a variety of audiences, both technical and non-technical
* Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely completion and distribution of communications materials
* Reviewing and revising project resources and other written materials to ensure quality, readability, and consistency
* Experience or interest in developing a communications strategy to publicize the research project and grow its audience; this may include pitching investigators and other subject matter experts for news articles, media appearances, and op-eds

**Qualifications:**

Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts, make them easily understandable through varied mediums, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine content.

Ability to collaborate effectively with numerous project stakeholders (e.g., investigators, administrative staff, university officials) at the university and with collaborators at other research institutions. Strong editing skills, ranging from developmental editing to copyediting. Graphic design experience is a plus but not required.

  

Minimum education: Bachelor’s Degree

Minimum Experience: 2+ years (3+ years preferred). Background in communications, public relations, marketing, or a related field is required. A background or experience working in academia or with clients in public health, economics, or policy is not required, but is preferred.

**Work Arrangement:**

Hybrid (3 days per week) on the University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA.

The hourly rate range for this position is $31.97 - $35.35. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy & Government Service develops evidence-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, the USC Schaeffer Institute includes four flagship centers: the Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics, the Center for Economic and Social Research, the Center for Civic Society and the Leonard D. You will drive each renewal from early planning to on-time closure, own the forecast and the visibility around it, and work closely with the Account Team.

In our model, Renewals is responsible for the renewal process, the forecast, and early risk detection, while the Account Executive remains Accountable for the commercial outcome and the customer relationship. You will partner closely with Customer Success, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations, and help define the playbooks, handoffs, and reporting.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Renewal Execution & Forecasting

* Drive the end-to-end renewal process for your book, from early planning through quote, contracting, negotiation support, and on-time close, including multi-year terms, co-terming, pricing uplifts, and partner, reseller, and marketplace renewals
* Deliver against the team's core KPIs: cohort renewal rate (renewals closed as a share of those up for renewal in the period), on-time renewal performance, and forecast accuracy
* Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and clear visibility into each renewal's stage and quote status from kickoff to signature, and report it regularly to leadership

Risk & Retention

* Accurately forecast risk once identified to ensure a plan can be put in place well in advance of the renewal
* Own execution of the save plan (the actions to retain an at-risk customer) alongside the Sales and Customer Success
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on renewal strategy, pricing, and negotiation, and support executive conversations on large accounts
* Analyze renewal and churn trends and share insights with Product, Customer Success, and GTM teams

Process & Partnership

* Run clear handoffs across Renewals, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Deal Desk
* Work with Finance and Sales Operations to streamline approvals, paperwork, and CRM data quality
* Build renewal playbooks, account plans, workflows, dashboards, and reporting that shorten cycle time and reduce manual work

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years of experience in renewals, account management, customer success, or sales/revenue operations, with direct ownership of a renewal-rate or retention number
* Experience managing renewals for enterprise accounts, including multi-year contracts, executive stakeholders, and customers across regions and time zones
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, data security, cloud security, or AI, with the ability to discuss customer value, adoption, and risk credibly with security and data leaders
* Experience negotiating or supporting complex enterprise contracts, including working with Legal on redlines and Finance on pricing approvals
* Ability to partner with Sales in a model where renewals execution is separate from commercial deal ownership
* Strong forecasting skills, with fluency in Salesforce and CPQ/CLM tools and the analytical ability to turn data into clear recommendations
* Experience improving processes, dashboards, or reporting with measurable impact, and comfort creating visibility where tooling falls short
* Executive presence and excellent cross-functional communication skills
* Experience with Clari, Ironclad, Gainsight, or similar tools, and with using AI tools to improve forecasting and workflows, is a plus

We are looking for a Social Media Specialist who combines a strong eye for interiors with thoughtful planning, clear writing, and a practical understanding of performance. jobs.title: Roofing Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Preferred Roofing is hiring a motivated, results-driven **Roofing Sales Representative** to grow our residential and commercial roofing business throughout Orange County.

**We have more company-generated leads than our current sales team can keep up with—and we're looking for the right salesperson to help us capitalize on the opportunity.**

You'll step into an environment with a strong flow of inbound opportunities while also having the ability to increase your earning potential through referrals, networking, door-to-door prospecting, and relationship building.

If you have experience in **roofing sales, home improvement sales, solar sales, construction sales, outside sales, or in-home sales**, we want to hear from you. Previous roofing experience is preferred but not required. Roofing and inspection training will be provided.

**Why Join Preferred Roofing?**

* **Expected compensation of $100,000–$150,000+ your first year**
* **Uncapped commission earning potential**
* **Strong pipeline of company-generated leads**
* Bonus opportunities
* Marketing and lead-generation support
* Ongoing roofing and sales training
* Mentorship from experienced industry professionals
* Inspection tools and technology provided
* Company-branded apparel
* Career advancement opportunities
* **Company vehicle upon reaching established sales-performance goals**
* Growing Southern California roofing company with 30+ years of experience**What You'll Do**

As a Roofing Sales Representative, you'll manage the customer relationship from initial contact through contract signing.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Respond quickly and professionally to company-generated roofing leads
* Generate additional residential and commercial roofing opportunities through door-to-door sales, referrals, networking, and relationship building
* Conduct on-site residential and commercial roof inspections with training and support
* Identify roofing concerns and clearly communicate inspection findings to customers
* Educate homeowners, property managers, landlords, and HOAs on roofing systems, materials, warranties, and financing options
* Prepare and present professional roofing estimates and sales proposals
* Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales process
* Address customer questions and objections and confidently ask for the sale
* Develop relationships with homeowners, property managers, landlords, HOAs, and referral partners
* Maintain an active roofing sales pipeline
* Accurately document leads, appointments, inspections, proposals, follow-ups, and closed sales in the CRM
* Meet or exceed established sales and revenue goals

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of sales experience preferred
* Roofing, home improvement, solar, construction, HVAC, windows, exterior remodeling, or other in-home sales experience strongly preferred
* Outside sales and/or door-to-door sales experience is a plus
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
* Proven ability to consistently follow up with prospects and close business
* Comfortable generating additional opportunities through prospecting and networking
* Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven
* Coachable and willing to learn roofing systems, materials, inspections, warranties, and financing
* Comfortable using CRM, proposal, and sales technology
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
* Ability to attend occasional evening or weekend customer appointments as needed

**What Success Looks Like**

During your first 90 days, you'll learn Preferred Roofing's products, inspection process, roofing systems, warranties, financing options, CRM, proposal tools, and sales process.

You'll shadow experienced team members, participate in roof inspections, learn how to identify common roofing concerns, and develop the ability to confidently present roofing solutions to homeowners and commercial property decision-makers.

As you progress, you'll independently conduct inspections, prepare and present proposals, manage company-generated opportunities, build your own pipeline, consistently follow up with prospects, and close residential and commercial roofing projects.

Performance will be measured through sales activity, including qualified opportunities generated, roof inspections completed, proposals delivered, follow-up activity, close rate, and roofing revenue generated.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who knows how to **earn trust rather than force a sale**.

You listen, ask good questions, communicate clearly, and make complicated decisions easier for customers to understand. You're personable enough to connect with a homeowner at their front door and professional enough to build credibility with a property manager, landlord, or HOA representative.

You know that having leads is only valuable if you know what to do with them. You're responsive, organized, persistent with follow-up, and motivated to turn opportunities into closed business.

Most importantly, you're **coachable, accountable, resilient, competitive, and motivated by measurable results.**

**About Preferred Roofing**

Preferred Roofing is a residential and commercial roofing company serving Southern California with more than **30 years of experience and 8,000+ completed roof replacements and repairs**.

Our mission is simple: **Customer Service is our #1 priority.**

We believe quality workmanship, honest communication, and an exceptional customer experience create customers who become raving fans. Preferred Roofing utilizes its own employees rather than relying solely on subcontractors, helping us maintain consistency and quality throughout the customer experience.

Our goal is ambitious: **build the biggest brand in roofing.**

If you're looking for a roofing sales career with **a strong flow of company-generated opportunities, uncapped earning potential, and room to grow**, we'd like to hear from you.

We are seeking the talents of a **Retail Operations Coordinator - West** to join our Retail Ops Team. This role is based in our West Hollywood office and requires regular domestic travel.

The Retail Operations Coordinator helps drive smooth day-to-day store operations and contributes to a cohesive, on-brand experience for Sézane customers and internal teams. This role prioritizes inventory accuracy, efficient operational execution, facilities coordination, and alignment of processes across Sézane’s West Coast retail fleet, working closely with Store Directors and cross-functional teams.

Reporting to the Retail Operations Manager US, the ideal candidate brings a blend of precision, analytical thinking, and adaptability, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves on tasks ranging from stockroom management and reporting to maintenance coordination, process implementation, and store technology.

**About the Role**

**Facilities & Maintenance**

* Serve alongside the Retail Operations Manager as a key point of contact for West Coast store maintenance requests, ensuring timely resolution and reliable communication with store teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, including obtaining and reviewing quotes, supporting vendor negotiations, scheduling work, and tracking projects through completion in partnership with the Retail Operations Manager.
* Support the day-to-day management of maintenance framework contracts and vendor relationships, monitoring costs, service levels, and adherence to agreed scopes and pricing.
* Assist in ensuring West Coast stores meet OSHA, ADA, fire, and applicable local safety and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate and schedule preventive maintenance for West Coast stores, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire safety, and other building systems, as well as maintenance needs associated with new store openings and renovations.
* Respond to urgent repair needs and support store teams with troubleshooting guidance, escalating as appropriate to the Retail Operations Manager.
* Monitor maintenance spend and quotes to help identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining appropriate service and brand standards.
* Ensure facilities maintain a clean, safe, functional, and brand-appropriate customer and employee environment.

**Back Office & Inventory Operations**

* Support daily, weekly, and monthly inventory operations across West Coast retail locations, including cycle counts and annual store inventories.
* Partner with HQ Logistics and store teams to ensure timely and accurate inventory movements, including inbound shipments, transfers, and outbound shipments/RTVs.
* Develop strong working knowledge of Sézane's retail, inventory, and planning tools and systems, serving as an operational resource for store teams and supporting troubleshooting and process adoption.
* Assist with inventory-related training materials, SOPs, and store communications.
* Support inventory processes during new store openings, store closures, system implementations, and special projects.
* Support the coordination and animation of the US stockist community, sharing best practices, operational updates, and tools to promote consistent stockroom standards across the network.

**Front of House Operations**

* Ensure customer-facing operational processes are consistent, efficient, and aligned with brand standards, including assisting with the creation and implementation of scalable SOPs and operational projects.
* Monitor key Customer Experience and operational KPIs, including guest rate, opt-in rate, mobile checkout rate, web orders, and other relevant metrics, helping identify trends and coordinate action plans with store teams and the Retail Operations Manager.
* Act as a point of contact for POS-related issues, escalations, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with onboarding and training store teams on POS enhancements, new tools, and operational workflows.
* Monitor store technology and devices, including iPads, scanners, printers, routers, and charging stations, and coordinate the replacement of outdated or damaged equipment.
* Monitor developments in retail technology and operational tools, benchmarking potential solutions and proposing opportunities to improve or digitize store operations.
* Participate in cross-functional Task Forces and special projects with Retail, IT, Logistics, Planning, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to support operational improvements and new initiatives.

**Store Visits & Reporting**

* Conduct structured 360° store visits across the West Coast fleet, assessing facilities, inventory, back-of-house operations, customer experience, technology, and overall operational standards, with clear reporting on observations, opportunities, and action items.
* Maintain a regular store visit cadence, with an expected minimum of once per month for LA locations and every two months

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's communications team is responsible for defining, shaping, promoting, and protecting the narrative around Anduril's products and people, both internally and externally. As part of Anduril's division comms vertical, you will support a specific suite of products, related contracts, and the team building them. The right person for this role is deadline-driven, an excellent communicator and extremely organized.

  

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The role supports Anduril's Connected Warfare division which builds the software, computing hardware, and networks that connect people, sensors, and autonomous systems across land, sea, air, and space. By bringing these systems and their data together, we help military teams build a shared picture of the battlefield, make faster decisions, and coordinate operations.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Help drive strategic and tactical communications programs that proactively advance Anduril's goals.
* Support external communications campaigns, including contract announcements, product launches, military exercise recaps, social media content, and executive thought leadership.
* Support earned media strategies and pitches to reporters to secure coverage in targeted media outlets where policymakers and influencers go to stay informed.
* Track, evaluate, and action incoming speaking requests.
* Work cross-functionally with partners in marketing, design, government relations, and across each of the business lines within the division.
* Support internal communications campaigns and events designed to ensure that the division runs effectively and employees remain inspired and informed.
* Help translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for non-technical audiences.

  

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1-2 years of communications experience in defense and national security, technology, policy, public relations, or related field(s)
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, and a passion for storytelling.
* Strong organizational, project management, and analytical skills.
* Strong interest in current events
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your app

Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **GENERAL PURPOSE**

Prepare in-house market research studies and reports using GIS applications and primary research methods. Provide support and data to the department on various projects associated with efforts to expand our store network and to analyze our existing stores. Prepare demographic, competitor, and other related analyses. Define trade areas; analyze the influences that affect the performance of our locations. Examine customer behavior. Analyze competitors’ growth strategies. Define and understand individual stores (or groups of stores) that do not perform to expectations. Create market penetration maps and reports. Collaboration

Business Acumen

Organizational Agility

Integrity & Good Judgement

### **QUALIFICATIONS & SPECIAL SKILLS REQUIRED**

* 2 years of experience in location strategy, spatial analytics, statistics, GIS, retail strategy, or related field.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by **LOIS**, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

**Role Summary:**
-----------------

Here's the honest pitch: field sales is a brand-new motion at Filevine, and we're looking for the person who builds it. Not runs a proven playbook — writes it. You'll be the first Filevine salesperson to plant a flag in your territory, and everything you learn on the ground becomes the blueprint for the reps who come after you. If "figure it out and build it from scratch" makes you lean in rather than flinch, keep reading.  
  
This is a true outside sales role. You'll be in the field at least four days a week — walking into law firms, meeting paralegals and attorneys face-to-face, working bar association events, and becoming the most familiar name in your territory for deposition services.  
  
This isn't an email job. It's not a Zoom job. You win by showing up — consistently, professionally, and with something useful to say every time. You'll also need range: the ability to build rapport in the reception area and get your foot in the door with a paralegal, and the sophistication to sit across from a managing partner and hold your own on price, value, and strategy. This is a premium-priced product in a market full of commodity providers — so you have to be able to sell the difference, not just the service. If you love the rhythm of door-to-door selling, can navigate a downtown legal corridor, and have the discipline to run a territory like your own small business, you'll thrive here. There is no ceiling on your earnings

### **What You'll Do**

* Build the playbook. As the first rep in your territory, you'll test what works, document it, and help shape the model Filevine scales from. Your wins and your lessons both matter.
* Own a defined geographic territory and build a daily route plan that maximizes face-to-face time with litigation attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants, and firm administrators.
* Spend at least four days per week in the field — walking into firms, dropping by reception, scheduling lunches, and turning every visit into a relationship.
* Get your foot in the door at every level: earn trust with paralegals and legal staff, then work your way up to the conversations with managing partners and firm administrators who sign off on the deal.
* Sell Filevine's full deposition stack — court reporting, remote depositions, and AI-powered products including Depo CoPilot — as a premium offering in a commodity market. You'll own the "why we're worth it" story.
* Drive initial customer enablement, training, and product adoption — get new firms up and running, walk them through their first depositions, and make sure they're confident with the product. (A dedicated in-house team handles full, ongoing trainings; your job is to spark and seed adoption.)
* Attend local and regional industry events: bar association meetings, CLEs, paralegal association mixers, and trial lawyer chapters. Be the visible Filevine presence in your market.
* Run disciplined prospecting: outbound calls, drop-bys, follow-ups, and a tight cadence on every account.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every visit, conversation, and opportunity in CRM (Salesforce). Forecast projected targets and deals.
* Partner closely with Operations, Scheduling, and Client Success to deliver a seamless deposition experience.

### **You'll Crush This Role If You Have**

* 3–5+ years of outside sales experience, ideally selling into law firms or to attorneys — court reporting, legal videography, e-discovery, medical records retrieval, or legal tech.
* An existing network in the local legal community.
* A builder's mindset — you're energized by white space, ambiguity, and being the one who figures out what works before there's a manual for it.
* A proven track record of building a book of business from in-person relationships — not inbound leads.
* The range to connect with anyone in the building: warm and credible with a paralegal, sharp and strategic with a managing partner.
* Demonstrated ability to learn a new industry quickly and translate insights to subject-matter experts (in this case, litigators).
* Comfort selling a premium product against cheaper alternatives — you know how to make value the conversation instead of price.
* High activity, high agency: you build your own pipeline, run your own day, and don't wait for marketing to hand you names.
* Comfort walking into a law firm cold, navigating gatekeepers, and earning a first conversation.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation; you live in or near your assigned territory.

### **Nice to Have**

* A referral network of attorneys, court reporters, videographers, and adjacent service providers.
* Familiarity with deposition workflows, litigation timelines, and how legal services are purchased.

Compensation Information: $110,000 - $140,000 + commission

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity -

jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator II
========================

**Location:** Onsite – Pleasanton, California  
**Reporting to:** Logistics Manager  
  
At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.  
  
As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.  
  
Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.  
  
**Overview**  
The Logistics Coordinator II is responsible for supporting warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, RMA parts handling and vendor returns, asset and inventory management, and day-to-day facilities coordination. This role serves as a key operational resource for inventory tracking, equipment receiving and outbound shipments, vendor and ticket coordination, and warehouse organization. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, hands-on, and comfortable working in fast-paced operational and warehouse environments while supporting both internal teams and customer-related initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

**Warehouse & Facilities Operations**

* Maintain warehouse organization including shelving, inventory placement, labeling, and cleanliness.
* Coordinate and support office and warehouse operational needs.
* Ensure warehouse areas remain clean, safe, and operationally efficient.
* Organize and maintain inventory storage areas for internal equipment and customer consignments.
* Support facilities coordination tasks as assigned.

**Shipping & Logistics**

* Coordinate shipping and receiving activities for internal and customer equipment.
* Palletize equipment for outbound shipments and deployment preparation.
* Perform FedEx drop-offs and support smaller shipment logistics.
* Validate incoming shipping orders and ensure order accuracy.
* Receive, organize, and shelve shipments after consignments are created by the sales team.
* Track shipment status and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely processing.

**RMA Support**

* Receive, inspect, and log inbound RMA replacement parts against open vendor cases.

* Prepare RMA shipping documentation and coordinate carrier pickups for vendor returns.
* Update RMA records with tracking numbers, serial numbers, and shipment status.
* Maintain organized, clearly labeled storage for RMA spares, pending returns, and defective parts.

**Ticketing & Vendor Coordination**

* Open and manage CoreSite tickets for Jenny orders and related facility requests.
* Coordinate with vendors, carriers, and data center personnel to support operational activities.
* Track ticket status and ensure timely completion of service requests.

**Asset & Inventory Management**

* Manage asset tracking for customer consignments and internal company equipment.
* Apply asset tags and maintain accurate asset documentation and inventory records.
* Track hardware lifecycle information including deployment, storage, return, and disposal status.
* Conduct inventory audits and assist with reconciliation activities.
* Maintain accurate records within asset management systems and spreadsheets.

---------------------------

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; technical certifications or related education preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in technical operations, warehouse coordination, IT support, or facilities operations preferred.
* Basic understanding of networking hardware, server equipment, and infrastructure environments.
* Experience with shipping/logistics processes and inventory management.

**Preferred**

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Hands-on technical troubleshooting ability
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation practices
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Customer service mindset with responsiveness and professionalism
* Comfortable working in warehouse, office, and data center environments
* Basic networking and hardware knowledge
* Ability to follow operational procedures and maintain accuracy
* Proactive problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments

jobs.title: Program Coordinator- Roy Reuther Older Adult Center
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator – Roy Reuther Older Adult Center**
========================================================

As a Program Coordinator at JASA's Roy Reuther Older Adult Center in Far Rockaway, Queens, you'll play an essential role in creating a welcoming, engaging, and supportive environment for older adults. You'll help coordinate daily programs and activities, support center operations, and develop opportunities for participants to stay socially connected, active, and engaged in their community.

**Shift Schedule:**  
Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

**Hours Per Week:**  
35

**Why You'll Love Working at JASA**
-----------------------------------

JASA is one of New York City's largest and most respected nonprofit organizations serving older adults. Every day, our team helps thousands of New Yorkers age with dignity, independence, and connection to their communities.

### **Top Reasons to Join Us**

**Make a Meaningful Impact**

* Help older adults remain active, socially connected, and engaged in their communities.
* Coordinate programs and activities that promote wellness, independence, and quality of life.
* Build positive relationships with participants while supporting their needs and interests.

**Mission-Driven & Collaborative Environment**

* Work alongside a dedicated team committed to serving older New Yorkers.
* Collaborate with staff, volunteers, community partners, and service providers.
* Contribute ideas that enhance center programming and the participant experience.

**Professional Growth**

* Develop your skills in program coordination, activity planning, and community engagement.
* Gain experience supporting older adult services and nonprofit program operations.
* Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Program Coordinator is an integral member of the Roy Reuther Older Adult Center team, helping coordinate daily programming, engage participants, and support the smooth operation of the center. This position focuses on developing and coordinating activities, maintaining program records, assisting with special events, and fostering an inclusive environment where older adults feel welcomed, valued, and connected.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

### **Program Coordination & Activities**

* Plan, coordinate, and implement recreational, educational, cultural, and social activities for older adult participants.
* Develop engaging programs that encourage social interaction, wellness, creativity, and lifelong learning.
* Assist with organizing special events, celebrations, workshops, and community activities.
* Maintain program calendars and activity schedules.
* Encourage participation and gather feedback to identify opportunities for program improvement.
* Ensure activities are inclusive and responsive to participants' interests and needs.

### **Participant Engagement & Support**

* Establish positive relationships with participants and respond to questions, concerns, and program-related needs.
* Provide information about center activities, services, and available community resources.
* Communicate program schedules, announcements, and updates to participants.
* Promote an environment that supports dignity, independence, respect, and social connection.
* Identify opportunities to improve participant engagement and overall satisfaction.
* Work collaboratively with center staff to support participants' experiences and needs.

### **Administrative & Recordkeeping Support**

* Maintain accurate attendance records, program documentation, and activity reports.
* Assist with preparing reports and maintaining required administrative records.
* Organize program materials, schedules, and related documentation.
* Support compliance with JASA policies, procedures, and applicable program requirements.
* Communicate relevant program updates and operational needs to the appropriate staff.

### **Center Operations**

* Assist with the daily operations of the Holliswood Older Adult Center to ensure programs and services run smoothly.
* Coordinate with staff and volunteers to support scheduled activities and special initiatives.
* Help maintain an organized, welcoming, and participant-friendly environment.
* Assist with addressing day-to-day operational needs as they arise.
* Support continuity of center activities and services.

### **Events & Community Engagement**

* Assist with planning and coordinating special events, celebrations, and community activities.
* Support outreach efforts that encourage older adults to participate in center programs.
* Coordinate with community partners and service providers as needed.
* Help promote awareness of center activities and opportunities for engagement.
* Assist with additional center initiatives and special projects as assigned.

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with colleagues to support the center's goals and priorities.
* Adapt to changing program needs and assist with special assignments.
* Work occasional additional hours for special events or program needs, as necessary.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

### **Education**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate degree or higher preferred.

### **Experience**

* One or more years of experience in program coordination, activity planning, community programming, or a related field highly preferred.
* Experience working with older adults, a senior center, or a community-based nonprofit organization is a plus.
* Experience coordinating events, facilitating group activities, or developing programs preferred.

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong organizational, time-management, and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Ellipsis Health builds AI products that take on healthcare's staffing shortages and administrative burden, pairing conversational AI with our patented voice biomarker technology to help deliver better healthcare for everyone. Our voice agents talk with patients every day: booking and rescheduling appointments, answering billing questions, handling medication refills, and checking in after a hospital visit.

This role drives growth and operations for our provider business, which serves health systems, provider groups, and FQHCs. You'll work across the provider teams within Ellipsis, from sales and deployment to customer success, product, and engineering, and report into provider segment leadership.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're seeking a Business Operations Associate to play a critical role in driving growth, operational excellence, and customer success. You'll work across three areas: business operations, customer experience, and data and analytics, using a combination of analytical, operational, and technical skills to evaluate key business problems while weighing the needs of a variety of stakeholders, from internal teams to senior health system leaders.

The ideal candidate blends strategic thinking, analytical horsepower, and hands-on execution, has exceptional attention to detail, high drive and low ego, and is energized by tackling the complex, interesting challenges of a rapidly scaling startup.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support and eventually lead internal business reviews, highlighting performance and optimization initiatives across the full funnel.
* Build scalable processes and playbooks for customer onboarding, deployment handoffs, and cross-functional workflows as the provider business grows.
* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for health system, provider group, and FQHC customers after go-live, partnering with the deployment team to keep programs on track.
* Run recurring customer check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews, translating program performance into clear outcomes and next steps.
* Monitor patient experience and program quality across our provider programs (outreach outcomes, escalations, and care coordinator handoffs), flagging and resolving issues before they reach the customer.

**About the Company**

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

**Our Ethos**

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

**About the Team**

The Platform team owns everything that happens after a partner signs with Rain: implementations, account management, support, and card network operations. Account Management is responsible for growing Rain's live partners, from developers and startups to enterprise card programs, through renewals, expansions into new products and regions, and commercial conversations.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will own renewals and expansions for a set of live partners in your coverage area, and be the person they go to when something about their partnership, program setup, contract, or products needs to change. Our Implementations team launches new partners; you take over once they are live. You will start by shadowing experienced AMs on renewals and expansions, then run them with an AM alongside you, then on your own.

**What you’ll do**

* Own renewals for the live partners, from the first conversation through signed paperwork
* Find and close expansion opportunities in your accounts, such as new products (cards, virtual accounts, on/offramps, wallets, cross-border payments), additional card programs, and new regions
* Grow net revenue retention (NRR) for your coverage area, and flag churn or contraction risk early
* Handle partner escalations that sit outside Support: questions about the partnership, program configuration, commercial terms, and products. Bring in Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance when needed and follow each one through to resolution
* Keep detailed account health and notes up to date
* Build a health snapshot of your accounts and use it to decide where to spend your time
* Pass partner feedback to Product to help shape the roadmap
* Help write and improve Account Management playbooks, including expansion playbooks for new products and features
* Learn Rain's products in depth, including stablecoin card issuing, card network basics, and our APIs

**You are likely to succeed if you have:**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in account management, as an account executive, or in customer success, in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS
* Comfort talking with partners about renewals, pricing, and commercial terms, and asking for the expansion when the opportunity is there
* Clear written and verbal communication on calls, over email, and in shared Slack channels with partners
* Strong organization: you can keep many accounts, deadlines, and follow-ups moving at the same time
* Curiosity about how payments work (card issuing, authorization, settlement) and about stablecoins, and a willingness to learn technical topics, including reading API documentation
* Ownership: when a partner raises an issue, you see it through to resolution, even when it needs help from several teams
* Comfort working at a fast-growing company

**Bonus attributes:**

* Exposure to card issuing, embedded finance, crypto, or stablecoins
* Experience working toward a renewal, upsell, or expansion target

**Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:**

**Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

**Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

**Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

**Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

**Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

**Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

**In-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

**Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $90K - $115K
